raw: “My car skidded on a patch of ice. The rear wheels were sliding toward a ditch, and there was a mailbox inches from my window. Inches—it’s different saying that now than being there with it right beside you. My attention went from the mailbox to the back of the car, because that was sliding toward the ditch, and I didn’t know what was going to happen next. That was what frightened me, not knowing where the car was going to end up. When I think about it, I keep coming back to how close that mailbox was.”
